derived_processing: Quadrant crops, optionally restricted to whole masonry courses (see source_crop_px), and nearest-neighbour resizing only. No synthesized PBR maps or procedural seam repair.
lighting_note: Diffuse stylized painted surface shading is baked; do not infer physical PBR maps.
qa_status: Visual QA complete. See per-role notes; no claim of pixel-perfect seamlessness.

materials.intended_use: warm cream fibrous rice-paper shoji surface with narrow dark wooden horizontal and vertical lattice, exact regular square repeat
materials.repeat_quality: Practical visually reviewed repeat; not pixel-edge-identical
materials.qa_note: Shoji paper lattice repeats accepted after cropping boundary frame halves. Do not mistake the baked wooden lattice for physical dividers; add geometry for silhouette/depth.

materials.intended_use: straw-gold finely woven tatami mat surface, parallel natural fiber pattern, restrained jade edging only as a flat repeating woven band
materials.repeat_quality: Practical visually reviewed repeat; not pixel-edge-identical
materials.qa_note: Tatami weave repeat accepted. Cropped side-band halves meet as one mat seam; use 2m per repeat or physical mat dimensions. Fine fiber moire at distance needs proper sampling.

materials.intended_use: warm aged cedar plank surface with straight quiet grain, refined traditional wooden structural material
materials.repeat_quality: Intentional nonrepeat component material / decorative panel
materials.qa_note: Flat surface accepted; map once per component UV0 0–1, not across room-scale repeats.

materials.intended_use: square indigo and sage dyed textile panel with a restrained original maple leaf and stream motif, flat cloth, no folds
materials.repeat_quality: Intentional nonrepeat component material / decorative panel
materials.qa_note: Flat surface accepted; map once per component UV0 0–1, not across room-scale repeats.

recommended_sampler.minification: NEAREST or nearest-mipmap-nearest; test fine textile weave at distance
recommended_sampler.color_management: Interpret PNG as sRGB and convert to linear only inside renderer

provenance.processing: Crop and nearest-neighbor resize only; visual QA contact assembly is not production image editing.

package_scope: Runtime textures, selected native previews and JSON QA are included. Original masters are in the optional lossless source-art bundle. Historical per-theme repeat/contact PNGs are retained locally, not shipped; regenerate diagnostics from runtime PNGs with assembly-src/render_material_qa.py.
